ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a vertical band along the peduncle midline and in dense, irregular mottling along the trailing edge boundaries. Scattered low-intensity pixels form a non-uniform speckle pattern across the medial white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the apex of 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous boundary; the right lobe exhibits sharp pixel-amplitude peaks (4-8 pixels) while the left lobe displays a significant irregular indentation/notch midway to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral S-curve profile characterized by convex curvature transitioning to concavity near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and sparsely along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the lower left lobe and vertical scratches visible in the medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular tissue deficit/indentation on the lower-left margin near the peduncle; significant calcified clusters on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive cluster of three dark, vertically aligned focal spots in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe surface.
